lines.en: label returntosummer1:
scene returntosummer1
: Finally! Maya and I have been waiting here for hours for you guys to get back!
lines.zh: : 终于！Maya 和我在这儿等了你们好几个小时了！

lines.en: : It’s probably only been around forty-five minutes, but you get the point.
lines.zh: : 大概也就四十五分钟吧，不过意思你懂的。

lines.en: : I...had no idea you two were even going to be here.
lines.zh: : 我……根本不知道你们俩会在这儿。

lines.en: scene returntosummer2
: What, really? Did none of my texts go through or something? I’ve been writing to Ami about it like all day.
lines.zh: : 什么，真的吗？我的短信一条都没发出去还是怎么的？我可是给 Ami 念叨了一整天。

lines.en: scene returntosummer3
: That’s weird. I haven’t gotten anything.
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。我一条都没收到。

lines.en: : But I probably wouldn’t have answered even if I did since Sensei and I were having so much fun.
lines.zh: : 不过就算收到了，我大概也不会回，因为 Sensei 和我玩得太开心了。

lines.en: scene returntosummer4
: Oh, okay. Okay. So that’s how it’s going to be, Ami. Fine.
lines.zh: : 哦，行吧。行吧。所以这就是你的态度了，Ami。好得很。

lines.en: : Sensei. Come with me. We’re going to take a bath together.
lines.zh: : Sensei。跟我来。我们要一起洗澡。

lines.en: : Alternatively, you could be slightly decent and remain here instead of debauching your home with your [niece] and the local shrine maiden right outside the bathroom door.
lines.zh: : 或者你可以稍微像样一点，留在这儿，别在你家里、就在浴室门外，和你的[niece]以及本地那位巫女一起堕落。

lines.en: : For everyone’s safety, I think I’m going to go with Maya’s suggestion and take a rain check on the...shared bathing experience.
lines.zh: : 为了大家的安全，我想我还是采纳 Maya 的建议，这次「共浴体验」就先欠着吧。

lines.en: scene returntosummer5
: So, what did you two do all day? I stopped by earlier this morning to say hi and no one was here, so I’m guessing you guys were pretty busy.
lines.zh: : 那么，你们俩一整天都干什么了？我今天早上顺路过来打了个招呼，一个人都没有，所以猜你们挺忙的。

lines.en: : I also stopped by, but it was just to eat your food. I am not sorry.
lines.zh: : 我也顺路来过，不过只是为了吃你们家的东西。我不觉得抱歉。

lines.en: : I’ll call the locksmith in the morning.
lines.zh: : 我明天早上就叫锁匠来。

lines.en: : Thanks, Ami.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Ami。

lines.en: : We just kind of wandered around the entertainment district and went out to eat. Nothing special.
lines.zh: : 我们就是在娱乐区随便逛了逛，然后去吃了顿饭。没什么特别的。

lines.en: Apart from the trip to the graveyard, of course. But I doubt anyone here wants to hear about that.
lines.zh: 当然，去墓园那趟除外。不过我怀疑在座没人想听那个。

lines.en: scene returntosummer6
: I made Sensei come with me to the manga shop so I could get the new volume of My Sweet Prince.
lines.zh: : 我拉着 Sensei 陪我去了漫画店，好买《我的甜心王子》的新一卷。

lines.en: : Ew.
: What’s that? I don’t know that one.
lines.zh: : 那是什么？我没听说过。

lines.en: : It’s probably best if you don’t look into it.
lines.zh: : 你最好别去查。

lines.en: scene returntosummer7
: You starting to get into the {i}weird{/i} stuff, Ami? I knew it was only a matter of time.
lines.zh: : 你开始往{i}奇怪{/i}的方向发展了啊，Ami？我就知道这只是时间问题。

lines.en: : There is nothing weird about the purest form of love there is.
lines.zh: : 这世上最纯粹的爱，可一点都不奇怪。

lines.en: : What? Why are you just looking at me?
lines.zh: : 什么？你们干嘛光盯着我看？

lines.en: : I was hoping there was a part of you who also felt like this situation was beginning to get a bit too awkward, but I realize now that I was mistaken in believing that was possible.
lines.zh: : 我本来还指望你心里至少还有一部分觉得这局面开始有点太尴尬了，现在我才明白，我指望错了。

lines.en: scene black
I return to the door to lock it and prevent anyone else from randomly showing up before returning to the living room to join the girls on the couch.
lines.zh: 我回到门口把门锁上，免得再有人随随便便闯进来，然后回到客厅，在沙发上加入女孩们。

lines.en: scene returntosummer8
: Are you excited to finally have summer back, Sensei? I know you get really depressed when you have to go long periods of time without seeing my exposed thighs.
lines.zh: : 终于把夏天盼回来了，你激动吗，Sensei？我知道你要是太久看不到我露出来的大腿，就会特别抑郁。

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} know that Sensei thinks your thighs could be a little slimmer. He told me earlier today.
lines.zh: : 而且{i}我{/i}知道 Sensei 觉得你的大腿可以再瘦一点。他今天早些时候跟我说了。

lines.en: : That’s not a thing I said.
lines.zh: : 那不是我说过的话。

lines.en: : You don’t have to {i}actually{/i} say it because I always know what you’re thinking.
lines.zh: : 你不用{i}真的{/i}说出来，因为我永远知道你在想什么。

lines.en: : I’m not really {i}excited{/i} to have summer back, but I do welcome the change. One more week of the cold and I probably would have died.
lines.zh: : 夏天回来我倒没多{i}激动{/i}，不过我欢迎这种变化。再冷一个星期，我大概就死了。

lines.en: scene returntosummer9
: Right?! I feel exactly the same!
lines.zh: : 对吧？！我完全也是这么想的！

lines.en: : Oh! And I forgot to tell you- I was talking to Touka earlier and she told me about how you and her family went out to do summery stuff together but you had no idea where to go.
lines.zh: : 哦！还有我忘了跟你说——我之前跟 Touka 聊过，她说你和她家人一起出去做夏日活动，却完全不知道该去哪儿。

lines.en: : Why didn’t you just ask me? I’m basically the queen of summer! I would have shown you guys everything there is to know!
lines.zh: : 你干嘛不来问我？我基本上就是夏日女王啊！我本来能带你们把该知道的都体验个遍！

lines.en: : Which is?
lines.zh: : 比如说？

lines.en: : You know!...Summer stuff!
lines.zh: : 你知道的嘛！……夏天的东西！

lines.en: scene returntosummer10
: Ami knows what I’m talking about! Right, Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami 知道我在说什么！对吧，Ami？

lines.en: : Huh? Oh! Uhh...yeah! Summer! Woo!
lines.zh: : 嗯？哦！呃……对！夏天！哇哦！

lines.en: scene returntosummer11
: Yeah! Woo!
lines.zh: : 对！哇哦！

lines.en: : So, after the whole summer thing, Touka and I got to talking about {i}more{/i} stuff and thought it might be cool if we could like, throw a pool party at her place sometime.
lines.zh: : 那么，在夏天那件事之后，Touka 和我又聊了{i}更{/i}多，觉得要是哪天能在她家办个泳池派对就挺酷的。

lines.en: : I highly doubt they’d let over twenty “commoners” in at once, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我严重怀疑他们会不会一次性放二十多个「平民」进去，Ayane。

lines.en: scene returntosummer12
: You must be forgetting that I’m {i}rich,{/i} Sensei. And since I’d be a guest of honor, I get a plus-twenty.
lines.zh: : 你大概是忘了我是{i}有钱人{/i}吧，Sensei。既然我是荣誉嘉宾，我就能带二十个人。

lines.en: : That is significantly more than the plus-one you’d get under normal circumstances.
lines.zh: : 这可比通常情况下你能带的「加一」多多了。

lines.en: : Different rules apply to rich people. And while I don’t like to flaunt them {i}that{/i} much, I know when to use my powers.
lines.zh: : 有钱人适用另一套规则。虽然我不{i}太{/i}爱显摆，但我知道什么时候该动用我的力量。

lines.en: : I’ll go. I probably won’t swim, but I’m assuming there will be a banquet of some sort.
lines.zh: : 我会去的。我大概不会下水，不过我猜那儿会有某种宴会。

lines.en: scene returntosummer13
: How about you, Ami? Ready to get your vacation on at the biggest mansion in Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 你呢，Ami？准备好去 Kumon-mi 最大的宅邸里度个假了吗？

lines.en: : From what I’ve heard, it makes my place look like-
lines.zh: : 听人说，那地方让我家看起来就像—

lines.en: scene returntosummer14
: Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami？

lines.en: : Is...everything okay?...
lines.zh: : 是……一切都还好吗？……

lines.en: scene returntosummer15
: Hm? What? Of course. Why wouldn’t it be?
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么？当然。为什么会不好呢？

lines.en: : Well...you just kinda zoned out for a second...
lines.zh: : 那个……你刚刚走神了好几秒……

lines.en: scene returntosummer16
: Oh! Hahaha...yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦！哈哈哈……是啊。

lines.en: : Guess it was a...long...
lines.zh: : 大概是……有点……久了……

lines.en: scene returntosummer17
: Actually...sorry! I’m gonna lay down. I don’t...feel too good...
lines.zh: : 其实……抱歉！我要去躺一会儿。我……不太舒服……

lines.en: : Do you...need tea or something? Medicine? I’ll go to the store for you!
lines.zh: : 你……需要茶什么的吗？药？我去给你买！

lines.en: : I’m okay! Just...have fun without me!
lines.zh: : 我没事！只是……你们别管我，玩你们的吧！

lines.en: scene black
Ami heads back into her room and the three of us are left mildly confused, but more worried than anything else.
lines.zh: Ami 回了自己房间，剩下我们三个有点摸不着头脑，更多的是担心。

lines.en: I’ve only seen Ami get sick once in the...roughly four cycles worth of time I’ve spent here. Which I guess would be around a year, maybe?
lines.zh: 我在这里度过的……大概四轮循环的时间里，只见过 Ami 生过一次病。算起来大概是一年？也许吧？

lines.en: And even then I feel like her sickness was just an excuse to try and get closer to me.
lines.zh: 而且即便那次，我也觉得她的病只是想借机跟我更亲近的借口。

lines.en: Things are different this time, though.
lines.zh: 不过这次不一样。

lines.en: Something seems wrong.
lines.zh: 有什么地方不对劲。

lines.en: scene returntosummer18
: Should we...maybe do something? Like...call a doctor?
lines.zh: : 我们要不要……做点什么？比如……请个医生？

lines.en: : Where did you two go out to eat? Do you think it could be food poisoning?
lines.zh: : 你们俩去哪儿吃的饭？会不会是食物中毒？

lines.en: : I think it’s best if we just...let her rest...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们最好还是……让她休息……

lines.en: scene returntosummer19
: If she needed our help, she would have asked Sensei to come with her. She probably just wants to be left alone.
lines.zh: : 如果她需要我们的帮助，她会让 Sensei 陪着她的。她大概只是想一个人待着。

lines.en: : Well...should we go home, then? I don’t think we should stay around if it’s going to disturb her.
lines.zh: : 那……我们要不回去吧？如果留下来会打扰她，我觉得不该待着。

lines.en: : Let's just step outside for a few minutes. Some fresh air would probably be good anyway.
lines.zh: : 我们就出去待几分钟。反正呼吸点新鲜空气大概也有好处。

lines.en: scene returntosummer20
: Mm...I guess she probably {i}would{/i} have asked for Sensei if it was actually bad...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想如果真的很严重，她应该{i}会{/i}叫 Sensei 的……

lines.en: : Okay. We can go out for some fresh air. But if Ami doesn’t want us to be here when we come back in-
lines.zh: : 好。那我们出去透透气。不过等我们回来时，如果 Ami 不想让我们在这儿—

lines.en: : We’ll walk home together. I know...
lines.zh: : 我们就一起走回家。我知道……

lines.en: scene black
Ayane and Maya make their way over to the door.
lines.zh: Ayane 和 Maya 朝门口走去。

lines.en: I attempt to follow them but stop in front of Ami’s for some reason.
lines.zh: 我本想跟上她们，却不知为何在 Ami 的房门前停下了脚步。

lines.en: Inside, I can faintly hear the sound of-
lines.zh: 在里面，我隐约能听见—

lines.en: : Sensei! Leave Ami alone for now! We can check on her in a little bit.
lines.zh: : Sensei！先别管 Ami！我们过一会儿再来看她。

lines.en: I follow Ayane outside.
lines.zh: 我跟着 Ayane 走了出去。

lines.en: scene returntosummer21
: Ahh! The fresh, pre-summer air! If only I could bottle some of it up and take it back to the dorms with me.
lines.zh: : 啊！这初夏前的新鲜空气！要是我能装一瓶带回宿舍就好了。

lines.en: : What exactly differentiates “pre-summer” air from regular summer air?
lines.zh: : 「初夏前」的空气和普通的夏日空气到底有什么区别？

lines.en: : Can you really not feel a difference?
lines.zh: : 你真的感觉不出区别吗？

lines.en: : Pre-summer air is like, a million times lighter. Like, it’s chilly...but not {i}so{/i} chilly that you need to put a jacket on.
lines.zh: : 初夏前的空气要轻盈上百万倍。就是……有点凉……但还没{i}凉{/i}到需要穿外套。

lines.en: : In summer, it’s like...I don’t know. A few steps away from that?
lines.zh: : 到了夏天，就像……我也不知道。离那个差几步远？

lines.en: scene returntosummer22
: Anyway, did the whole pool party thing sound okay to you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，泳池派对那事你觉得行吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Uta would normally be my go-to girl to plan something like this, but nobody seems to be able to get a hold of her today.
lines.zh: : 这种事我本来第一个会找 Uta 一起策划，可今天似乎谁都联系不上她。

lines.en: : I’m like, one or two steps away from asking Makoto to help out. Which doesn’t mean I have anything against Makoto or anything, but-
lines.zh: : 我差不多就差一两步就要去找 Makoto 帮忙了。倒不是我对 Makoto 有什么意见，只是—

lines.en: scene returntosummer23
: Hey, random question. Are you pregnant?
lines.zh: : 嘿，随便问个问题。你怀孕了吗？

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya—

lines.en: : Sorry...what did you just say?
lines.zh: : 抱歉……你刚才说什么？

lines.en: : “Hey, random question. Are you pregnant?”
lines.zh: : 「嘿，随便问个问题。你怀孕了吗？」

lines.en: scene returntosummer24
: So...is this like...
lines.zh: : 所以……这是……

lines.en: : Some kind of joke? Or...
lines.zh: : 某种玩笑？还是……

lines.en: : Probably. And Maya clearly isn’t very well-versed when it comes to comedy, so-
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。而且 Maya 显然不太懂什么叫幽默，所以—

lines.en: : I’m being 100%% serious. And I need to know right now.
lines.zh: : 我是 100%% 认真的。而且我现在就需要知道。

lines.en: : What do you mean you need to know right-
lines.zh: : 什么叫你现在就需要知—

lines.en: scene returntosummer25
: I mean that we are running out of time and I need to know {i}right now.{/i} Immediately. This very instant.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是我们时间不多了，我{i}现在{/i}就需要知道。立刻。就现在这一秒。

lines.en: : How many more ways do you need me to express the urgency of this? Because I’m starting to run out of patience.
lines.zh: : 到底还要我用多少种方式表达这件事有多紧急？因为我的耐心快见底了。

lines.en: : How...
lines.zh: : 怎么……

lines.en: : I mean, how could I be {i}pregnant?{/i} I don’t have anyone who I-
lines.zh: : 我是说，我怎么可能{i}怀孕{/i}？我根本没有那种人—

lines.en: scene returntosummer26
: Sensei, obviously. Which you shouldn’t be that surprised to hear I know about since you two have been screwing each other basically all school year.
lines.zh: : Sensei，显然啊。你听到我知道这事也不必太惊讶，毕竟你们俩基本上整个学年都在互相操。

lines.en: : Maya, leave her alone. Ayane didn’t do anything-
lines.zh: : Maya，别说了。Ayane 什么都没做—

lines.en: : Blah blah blah. I don’t need to know who did what. I just need to know if there’s a...thing growing inside of her.
lines.zh: : 废话废话废话。我不需要知道谁干了什么。我只需要知道她身体里有没有……长个东西。

lines.en: scene returntosummer27
: Go back inside.
lines.zh: : 回屋里去。

lines.en: : Do you...think you can give me orders? I am literally doing this {i}for you{/i}.
lines.zh: : 你……以为你能命令我吗？我做这些可都是{i}为了你{/i}。

lines.en: : Everyone could disappear at literally {i}any{/i} second right now, and as the person who’s basically responsible for bringing everyone back, I {i}kind of{/i} need to know who to wait around for.
lines.zh: : 现在在场的每一个人都可能在{i}下一秒{/i}彻底消失，而作为那个基本上负责把大家带回来的人，我{i}得{/i}知道该等谁。

lines.en: : Wait...around for? What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 等……谁？什么意思？

lines.en: : It doesn’t mean anything and you shouldn’t have to worry about it.
lines.zh: : 什么意思都不是，你也不必操心。

lines.en: : Did you really have to pick {i}now{/i} to start playing white knight? It would be such an easy question for her to answer if you’d just let her speak.
lines.zh: : 你非得挑{i}现在{/i}开始扮演白马骑士吗？你要是让她开口，这问题对她来说多好回答。

lines.en: scene returntosummer28
: Maya, {i}please{/i} don’t tell anyone else about Sensei and me. If word gets out about this and he loses his job, I’ll-
lines.zh: : Maya，{i}求你{/i}别把我和 Sensei 的事告诉别人。要是这事传出去，他丢了工作，我会—

lines.en: : I’m not interested in spreading rumors about who’s sleeping with who. I literally just need to know if you’re pregnant. That’s it.
lines.zh: : 我没兴趣散布谁跟谁上床的谣言。我真的只需要知道你有没有怀孕。就这点。

lines.en: : You don’t have to answer that, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你不必回答她，Ayane。

lines.en: scene returntosummer29
: Jesus fucking Christ! Can you let me talk to her without interrupting for a fucking second, please?!
lines.zh: : 操他妈的耶稣基督！你能不能让我跟她说句话，别他妈一直打断，行吗？！

lines.en: : You mean like how you interrupted us to invade her privacy?
lines.zh: : 你是说就像你打断我们、侵犯她隐私那样？

lines.en: : Oh, {i}excuse me{/i} for trying to protect you! We need to go back to doing things the way they need to be done or you’ll...{i}I’ll{/i} wind up alone again!
lines.zh: : 哦，{i}抱歉{/i}啊，我这是在保护你！我们得回到该有的做法上去，不然你会……{i}我又会{/i}落得孤身一人！

lines.en: : And since when do you care about anyone’s privacy? You basically make a living by walking in on girls as they’re getting dressed.
lines.zh: : 还有，你什么时候开始在乎别人的隐私了？你简直就是靠撞见女生换衣服过活的。

lines.en: : Guys...
lines.zh: : 各位……

lines.en: : I’m just saying that there’s a right way and a wrong way to do this and just jumping on her is wrong.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，这事有对的做法和错的做法，一上来就扑她是错的。

lines.en: : Are you forgetting that {i}you’re{/i} the one who told me this was a possibility? Or is jumping on Ayane something only {i}you’re{/i} permitted to do and I have to submit a fucking application for it?
lines.zh: : 你忘了是{i}你自己{/i}告诉我这有可能的吗？还是说，扑 Ayane 这种事{i}只有你{/i}被允许做，我就得他妈先递份申请？

lines.en: : Guys...stop yelling...Ami’s window is right there...
lines.zh: : 各位……别喊了……Ami 的窗户就在那儿……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have told you anything if I knew you were going to try and pull intimate information out of her like it’s something as meaningless as a favorite color.
lines.zh: : 我要是知道你会试着从她嘴里撬出这种私密信息，像问最喜欢的颜色那么轻描淡写，我什么都不会告诉你。

lines.en: : Children might be unimportant or insignificant to us, but Ayane wants one more than anything in the world.
lines.zh: : 孩子对我们来说也许无关紧要，但 Ayane 想要一个，胜过这世上的一切。

lines.en: : Then she should be excited to share the joyous news of her impending burden with me.
lines.zh: : 那她就该乐于把这个即将来临的「负担」的喜讯分享给我。

lines.en: : Guys!
lines.zh: : 各位！

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya—

lines.en: : Listen to me. Your [niece] is probably inside fucking {i}disintegrating{/i} right now. And I need to know if there are going to be any {i}surprises{/i} on the roof this time before it’s too late.
lines.zh: : 听我说。你的[niece]现在大概正在屋里一点点{i}崩解{/i}。我需要知道这次屋顶上会不会有什么{i}意外{/i}，趁现在还来得及。

lines.en: : And if Ayane {i}is{/i} pregnant, then what?
lines.zh: : 那如果 Ayane {i}怀孕{/i}了，又怎样？

lines.en: scene returntosummer30
: Then what, Maya?
lines.zh: : 那又怎样，Maya？

lines.en: : I’m not pregnant!
lines.zh: : 我没怀孕！

lines.en: scene returntosummer31
: I’m not...pregnant...
lines.zh: : 我没有……怀孕……

lines.en: : How sure are you? When was your last period? When was the last time you two-
lines.zh: : 你有多确定？你上次月经是什么时候？你们上次—

lines.en: : I’m...really sure, Maya.
lines.zh: : 我……真的很确定，Maya。

lines.en: : I check every time he...you know.
lines.zh: : 每次他……你知道的。之后我都会检查。

lines.en: scene returntosummer32
: I’m sure it probably sounds crazy, but...I’ve been kind of hoping {i}to{/i} get pregnant. That’s why I’m always checking.
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来大概很疯狂，但……我一直有点希望{i}能怀上{/i}。所以我才总在检查。

lines.en: : Yes, that sounds absolutely insane.
lines.zh: : 对，这听起来绝对是疯了。

lines.en: : I’m just...really excited to be a mom one day. More than anything in the-
lines.zh: : 我只是……很期待有一天能当妈妈。胜过这世上的—

lines.en: : Okay, Ayane. I am...flattered that this is information you suddenly want to share with me, but I really just needed a yes or no answer.
lines.zh: : 好了，Ayane。你突然想跟我分享这些信息，我很……受宠若惊，但我真的只需要一个是或否。

lines.en: : It’s done. I apologize for the spontaneity of the question, but it was very important to figure this out now rather than later.
lines.zh: : 说完了。我为这个突然的问题道歉，但这件事现在搞清楚比以后搞清楚重要得多。

lines.en: scene returntosummer33
: What’s...going on?...
lines.zh: : 到底……发生了什么？……

lines.en: : I’m still trying to process the fact that you even {i}know{/i} about us, but...what was up with all of that other stuff you said?
lines.zh: : 我还在消化「你居然{i}知道{/i}我们俩的事」这个事实，不过……你刚才说的那些别的东西是怎么回事？

lines.en: : ...hah. I guess there’s no harm in telling you since you’ll probably forget it by tomorrow anyway.
lines.zh: : ……哈。反正你大概明天就会忘掉，告诉你也没什么坏处。

lines.en: : Forget what? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 忘掉什么？你在说什么？

lines.en: scene black
Maya moves toward Ayane while I remain in place.
lines.zh: Maya 朝 Ayane 走去，而我留在原地。

lines.en: I’m relieved to hear that I can go one more day without being a father, but...
lines.zh: 听到自己还能再当一天不是爸爸的人，我松了口气，但……

lines.en: Hearing Ayane putting to words the death of her dream makes it hard for me to walk.
lines.zh: 听着 Ayane 把她的梦想之死说出口，我连走路都很艰难。

lines.en: It makes it hard for me to do anything really.
lines.zh: 真的让我什么都做不了。

lines.en: So I remain in place.
lines.zh: 于是我留在原地。

lines.en: I become a statue.
lines.zh: 我变成了一座雕像。

lines.en: And I watch in irony as everything but me crumbles to pieces.
lines.zh: 而我讽刺地看着，除我之外的一切崩落成碎片。

lines.en: scene returntosummer34
: Random question part two- the less depressing version.
lines.zh: : 随便问个问题·第二弹——不那么丧的版本。

lines.en: : Do you remember anything about a particular group hug you may have shared on the rooftop of the school recently? Or the disappearance of virtually your entire class?
lines.zh: : 你还记不记得，最近你们可能在学校天台上共享过一次集体拥抱？或者你整个班的人几乎都消失过？

lines.en: : Rooftop? No, but...
lines.zh: : 天台？不记得，不过……

lines.en: scene returntosummer35
: Sensei...didn’t you ask me the same question a few months ago? Along with some...sleepover that I apparently skipped out on?
lines.zh: : Sensei……几个月前你不是问过我同样的问题吗？还问了什么我 apparently 缺席了的过夜聚会？

lines.en: : ...yeah. It was the same night you said you lost something.
lines.zh: : ……对。就在你说你弄丢了什么东西的同一个晚上。

lines.en: Which...I’m just now starting to understand the meaning of.
lines.zh: 而那句话的意思……我现在才开始明白。

lines.en: The pit that sprouted roots in my stomach earlier is now a full grown tree.
lines.zh: 早先在胃里扎下根的坑洞，如今已经长成一棵参天大树。

lines.en: Each second carves a new marking into it.
lines.zh: 每一秒都在它身上刻下新的印记。

lines.en: scene returntosummer36
: So, basically, all of us are caught in an infinite time loop and, up until recently, I was the only one who was aware of this.
lines.zh: : 简单来说，我们所有人都被困在一个无限的时间循环里，而直到最近，只有我一个人意识到这件事。

lines.en: : Sensei, who was not Sensei for a very long time, is now Sensei again.
lines.zh: : 那个很长一段时间里并非 Sensei 的 Sensei，现在又是 Sensei 了。

lines.en: : We need to make it up to the roof and hug in order to turn time back and if you were pregnant, it might not work.
lines.zh: : 我们得爬上屋顶拥抱，才能把时间转回去；而如果你怀孕了，这可能就不灵了。

lines.en: : Now you know everything. Enjoy it for the next few hours before it’s wiped away along with any memory of this conversation.
lines.zh: : 现在你什么都知道了。好好享受吧，反正再过几个小时，它就会连同这段对话的记忆一起被抹掉。

lines.en: scene returntosummer37
: So...since Maya isn’t telling me, can you fill me in on what’s actually going on, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那么……既然 Maya 不肯告诉我，你能不能跟我说说到底怎么回事，Sensei？

lines.en: : I don’t know what kind of response I expected out of that...
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己本来期待得到什么样的回应……

lines.en: : It’s probably best to just...not think about it, Ayane. It’s getting late and I don’t want you crying any more than you already have.
lines.zh: : 最好还是……别去想了，Ayane。天晚了，我不想让你哭得比现在更厉害。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Why did you tell Maya about us?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么把我们的事告诉 Maya？……

lines.en: : Because-
lines.zh: : 因为—

lines.en: : Because I’m mean and I bullied him into telling me, just like how I bullied you.
lines.zh: : 因为我刻薄，我逼他说的，就像我逼你一样。

lines.en: : I’m just a big jerk and everyone can blame everything on me because that is both the easiest scenario and the least overall time consuming.
lines.zh: : 我就是个大混蛋，所有人都可以把一切怪到我头上，因为这既是最省事的局面，也是最不耗时间的。

lines.en: scene returntosummer38
: And you...promise you’re not going to tell anyone about this?
lines.zh: : 还有你……保证不会把这件事告诉任何人？

lines.en: : What I promise doesn’t really matter since you probably won’t even remember me {i}making{/i} the promise, but sure.
lines.zh: : 我保证什么其实并不重要，因为你大概连我{i}做过{/i}这个承诺都不记得，不过行吧。

lines.en: : I have nothing to gain from telling anyone and...significantly much more to lose.
lines.zh: : 我说出去什么好处也捞不着，而且……会失去的多得多。

lines.en: : Your disgusting secret is safe with me, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你那恶心的秘密在我这儿很安全，Ayane。

lines.en: scene returntosummer39
: Hey.
: Oh, shut up.
lines.zh: : 哦，闭嘴。

lines.en: : This is all still...really...{i}really{/i} weird...but as long as that secret’s safe, I’m happy.
lines.zh: : 这一切还是……真的……{i}真的{/i}很奇怪……但只要那个秘密安全，我就开心了。

lines.en: : Well, not {i}as{/i} happy as I would be if I really {i}was{/i} pregnant. But happy that I can continue to have sex with Sensei without having to worry about Maya finding out.
lines.zh: : 当然，要是{i}真怀上{/i}了我会{i}更开心{/i}。不过能继续跟 Sensei 上床而不用担心被 Maya 发现，我也很开心。

lines.en: : Did you hear the sentence I just had to process because you wouldn’t let Ayane just answer a fucking yes or no question without getting in the way?
lines.zh: : 你听见我刚刚因为你不让 Ayane 好好回答一个是或否的问题、而不得不处理的那句话了吗？

lines.en: : This is going to sound rich coming from me, but I’d appreciate it if you would think of each other’s feelings a little more often.
lines.zh: : 这话从我说出来可能挺讽刺，但我还是希望你们能多为对方的感受想想。

lines.en: : Yeah. That sounds {i}very{/i} rich. And wrong.
lines.zh: : 是啊。确实{i}挺讽刺{/i}。而且说错了。

lines.en: scene returntosummer40
: I feel like we should all hug. I still don’t get it, but I think we just went through a very emotional, dynamic-changing moment together.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们应该抱一个。我还是没搞懂，但我觉得我们刚刚一起经历了一个情绪激烈、能改变格局的时刻。

lines.en: : Or we can...not hug?
lines.zh: : 或者我们……可以不抱？

lines.en: : It’s okay, Maya. I’m not pregnant so you won’t crush the baby.
lines.zh: : 没关系，Maya。我没怀孕，所以你压不到宝宝。

lines.en: scene returntosummer41
: Okay. I’m done here.
lines.zh: : 好了。我先撤了。

lines.en: : Wait, I’ll come with you. I want to check on Ami anyway.
lines.zh: : 等等，我跟你一起。我也想去看看 Ami。

lines.en: : Are you really okay, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你真的没事吗，Ayane？

lines.en: scene returntosummer42
: No.
lines.zh: : 没事。

lines.en: : But I will be.
lines.zh: : 但我会没事的。

lines.en: : I’m sure everything will be fine in the morning.
lines.zh: : 我确信明天一早一切都会好起来。

lines.en: scene black
: Me too.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: scene returntosummer43
: How come {i}you’re{/i} the quiet one all of a sudden, Maya? This is supposed to be my time to act all depressed and stuff.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}怎么突然变成安静的那个了，Maya？现在该轮到我演忧郁少女了吧。

lines.en: : I’m almost always the quiet one. There was just a notable exception tonight since the world’s most worthless teacher decided to push my buttons at the worst possible time.
lines.zh: : 我几乎一直都是安静的那个。今晚只是个显著的例外，因为全世界最没用的老师挑了最糟糕的时机来按我的按钮。

lines.en: scene returntosummer44
: You can push {i}my{/i} buttons any time you want, Sensei. And by buttons I mean-
lines.zh: : 你想按{i}我的{/i}按钮随时都行，Sensei。我说的按钮是指—

lines.en: : I know what you mean, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我知道你指什么，Ayane。

lines.en: : I’m glad I’m theoretically only going to have to put up with one night of this.
lines.zh: : 我很庆幸理论上我只需要忍受今晚这一回。

lines.en: scene returntosummer43
: Oh. Should we maybe make some soup for Ami or something? Do we have a cold compress? What about...ginger?
lines.zh: : 哦。我们要不要给 Ami 煮点汤什么的？有冷敷袋吗？还有……姜？

lines.en: : I have no idea what’s wrong with her so I’m just going to do a little bit of everything and hope that something works.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她到底怎么了，所以我打算什么都来一点，指望其中一样管用。

lines.en: : What part of “leave her alone” did you not understand?
lines.zh: : 「别管她」这几个字你是哪部分没听懂？

lines.en: : Obviously the “leave her alone” part. She’s my best friend and it’s my duty to take care of her when she’s not feeling well.
lines.zh: : 显然是「别管她」那部分。她是我最好的朋友，她不舒服的时候照顾她是我的职责。

lines.en: scene returntosummer44
: I’m going to make tea. Sensei, do you want any? Or will you feel obligated to impregnate me out of gratitude?
lines.zh: : 我要去泡茶。Sensei，你要吗？还是说你会因为感激而觉得自己有义务让我怀孕？

lines.en: : I’m sorry Ayane, but I can’t imagine feeling “obligated” to do that...ever.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊 Ayane，但我想象不出自己「有义务」做那种事……什么时候都一样。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll have some tea, though.
lines.zh: : 那我还是喝点茶吧。

lines.en: scene returntosummer45
I return to the bedroom and prepare for what may or may not be my last slumber before-
lines.zh: 我回到卧室，为那可能、也可能不是我最后的一次睡眠做准备，直到—

lines.en: : Wait, Sensei! You forgot to tell me what kind you wanted!
lines.zh: : 等等，Sensei！你还没告诉我你要哪种！

lines.en: : Any type is fine, Ayane. I really don’t care.
lines.zh: : 哪种都行，Ayane。我真的不在乎。

lines.en: : What? I can’t hear you!
lines.zh: : 什么？我听不见！

lines.en: : I said-
lines.zh: : 我说—

lines.en: : What?! You’re going to have to speak up-
lines.zh: : 什么？！你得大声点—

lines.en: scene black
: I said I’m fine with-
lines.zh: : 我说我随便—

lines.en: scene happy7

: Any type...
lines.zh: : 随便哪种……

lines.en: My feet sink into the floor and an air of {s}concern{/s} CALLOUSNESS washes over me.
lines.zh: 我的双脚陷进地板，一股「{s}关切{/s}」的冷漠席卷了我。

lines.en: I do not know why they sink, for I would never leave this place if given the option anyway.
lines.zh: 我不知道它们为何下陷，因为如果可以选择，我根本不会离开这个地方。

lines.en: If this is some preventative measure to keep me from leaving, I can assure you it is unnecessary.
lines.zh: 如果这是某种阻止我离开的预防措施，我可以向你保证，那毫无必要。

lines.en: But do you know what is necessary?
lines.zh: 但你知道什么是必要的吗？

lines.en: : WHERE IS MY TEA????
lines.zh: : 我的茶呢？？？？

lines.en: That darn Ayane- too busy trying to be inseminated to do her job!
lines.zh: 那个该死的 Ayane——光顾着想被授精，连自己的活儿都不干了！

lines.en: And don’t even get me started about that {i}Maya{/i} girl. She’s a whoooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo
lines.zh: 还有那个 {i}Maya{/i} 也别让我开腔。她是个whoooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo

lines.en: le other story.
lines.zh: 另一回事。

lines.en: scene returntosummer47
: You know so much, yet see so little!
lines.zh: : 你知道得那么多，却看得那么少！

lines.en: scene returntosummer48
: You dream so little, yet do so much!
lines.zh: : 你梦得那么少，却做得那么多！

lines.en: The second figure goes off-script a little, but he’s doing his best so I decide not to say anything.
lines.zh: 第二个身影略微偏离了剧本，不过他已经很努力了，所以我决定什么也不说。

lines.en: : Winter is over! Summer has come!
lines.zh: : 冬天结束了！夏天到来了！

lines.en: : Summer is here! Fun in the sun!
lines.zh: : 夏天来了！阳光下的狂欢！

lines.en: : Did he enjoy his time away?
lines.zh: : 他享受离开的这段时光吗？

lines.en: : Was there pleasure upon higher grounds?
lines.zh: : 高处是否也有欢愉？

lines.en: : There is pleasure everywhere! He lives for it! Drinks it!
lines.zh: : 欢愉无处不在！他为它而活！畅饮它！

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
: Swallows it whole! Grows every day!
lines.zh: : 将它整个吞下！每天都在成长！

lines.en: else:
: Everywhere but the one place it should be!
lines.zh: : 除了那个本该存在的地方，无处不在！

lines.en: : Headed for chaos! The bridge gives out!
lines.zh: : 通往混乱！桥要塌了！

lines.en: show hope
: ENOUGH
lines.zh: : 够了

lines.en: : {s}sssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssss{/s}
lines.zh: : {s}sssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssssss{/s}

lines.en: : {s}kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk{/s}
lines.zh: : {s}kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk{/s}

lines.en: : HELLO AGAIN
lines.zh: : 又见面了

lines.en: A mass of white flesh or at least a flesh-like substance appears before me.
lines.zh: 一团白色的肉、或者至少是肉状的物质，出现在我面前。

lines.en: I can not see its entirety, but my stomach drops regardless.
lines.zh: 我看不见它的全貌，但我的胃还是沉了下去。

lines.en: It is not our first meeting, yet I can’t recall what was.
lines.zh: 这不是我们的第一次相遇，我却记不起那是什么。

lines.en: Somewhere in the back of my mind, a blurred memory attempts to escape only to be cut down by a thick tendril protruding from the center of the white mass.
lines.zh: 在我脑海深处的某个地方，一段模糊的记忆试图逃离，却被一根从白色物质中心伸出的粗壮触手斩断。

lines.en: It fucks my brain like the tight, nubile vagina of the girl who willingly erodes her sanity for a chance at happiness alongside a man who does not deserve it.
lines.zh: 它操着我的大脑，就像一个甘愿为了和一个配不上她的男人一起获得幸福的机会、而磨损自己理智的女孩那紧致而娇嫩的小穴。

lines.en: : IT APPEARS YOU HAVE HAD A BUSY SEASON
lines.zh: : 看来你这个季节过得挺忙

lines.en: : HOW INTERESTING THAT YOU HAVE COME YET AGAIN
lines.zh: : 你又一次来了，真有意思

lines.en: : YOUR SMELL IS THE SAME BUT YOUR EYES DO NOT GLOW WITH THE LIGHT OF LAST SUMMER
lines.zh: : 你的气味依旧，可你的眼中已不再有去年夏天的光芒

lines.en: : TELL ME CHILD, WHEN CAN I EXPECT YOUR WHOLE SELF???
lines.zh: : 告诉我，孩子，我何时才能等到完整的你？？？

lines.en: : HOW MUCH MORE DO YOU NEED TO GROW???
lines.zh: : 你还需要成长多少？？？

lines.en: I can not speak. For if I could, the words would simply bounce off of the creature and impale me.
lines.zh: 我说不出话。因为就算说出口，那些话也只会从那生物身上弹回来，把我刺穿。

lines.en: : YOUR WORDS ARE NOT NECESSARY
lines.zh: : 你不需要言语

lines.en: : I UNDERSTAND THEM EVEN WHEN SILENT
lines.zh: : 即使沉默，我也懂

lines.en: : COME CLOSER
lines.zh: : 靠近些

lines.en: : THERE IS SOMETHING I WANT TO SHOW YOU
lines.zh: : 有样东西我想给你看

lines.en: : Listen to Him! Follow the light!
lines.zh: : 听他的话！追随那道光！

lines.en: : Blind yourself by His glory! Drink until you are bloated beyond belief!
lines.zh: : 被他的荣光刺瞎双眼！畅饮到膨胀得难以置信！

lines.en: : THERE IS NO NEED TO BE SCARED
lines.zh: : 不必害怕

lines.en: : I SHOW YOU ONLY YOUR TRUEST SELF
lines.zh: : 我只向你展示你最真实的自我

lines.en: : A BEAUTIFUL MEMORY NOT FAR OFF FROM WHAT YOU’VE SEEN SO RECENTLY
lines.zh: : 一段美丽的记忆，与你不久前所见的相差无几

lines.en: : DOES IT WARM WHAT IS LEFT OF YOU KNOWING THAT SOMEONE STILL CARES???
lines.zh: : 知道还有人在乎你，是否温暖了你残存的部分？？？

lines.en: : SAVOR IT
lines.zh: : 细细品味

lines.en: : TASTE IT
lines.zh: : 尝一尝

lines.en: : COME
lines.zh: : 来

Before me, in the place of someone I held dear, is an avatar of myself.
lines.zh: 在我面前，本该是我珍视之人所在的地方，站着一个我自己的化身。

lines.en: It squirms as the machine plays hell upon the inside of {s}my{/s} its body, yet no gasps of pain or moans of pleasure escape it.
lines.zh: 机器在{s}它的{/s}体内肆虐，它扭动着，却没有一声痛苦的喘息或欢愉的呻吟逃出来。

lines.en: Seemingly devoid of all life, it surrenders itself to the will of something even more inanimate.
lines.zh: 它似乎完全没有生气，把自己交给了某种比它更无生命的东西的意志。

lines.en: : WHAT IS IT YOU SEE???
lines.zh: : 你看到了什么？？？

lines.en: : GAZE UPON YOURSELF IN YOUR TRUEST FORM
lines.zh: : 凝视你最真实的形态下的自己

lines.en: : LEARN TO ACCEPT THE LIFE YOU TURN AWAY FROM
lines.zh: : 学会接受你一再转身逃离的人生

lines.en: : YOU ARE SCARED
lines.zh: : 你在害怕

lines.en: : THE FEAR IS WHAT MAKES YOU HUMAN
lines.zh: : 恐惧造就你的人性

lines.en: : THE FEAR IS WHAT MAKES YOU WHOLE
lines.zh: : 恐惧造就你的完整

lines.en: : FEEL IT
lines.zh: : 感受它

lines.en: : SAVOR IT
lines.zh: : 品味它

lines.en: : COME
lines.zh: : 来

lines.en: Before me, in reverse, is a medley of catastrophe.
lines.zh: 在我面前，倒放着的是一场灾难的混剪。

lines.en: I float downward and the world flips, teaching me that having wings alone does not make one an expert at flying.
lines.zh: 我向下飘落，世界翻转，教会我：光有翅膀并不能让人成为飞行的行家。

lines.en: The song of skin slapping skin severs the smallest semblance of silence this cesspool of salvation spreads out before me.
lines.zh: 皮肉拍打皮肉的歌声，斩断了这片救赎的污水池在我面前铺开的那点最微弱的寂静。

lines.en: And in the midst of my uncertainty and the summit of my fear, I understand what it means to be whole and why I slice myself into pieces every single morning.
lines.zh: 在我的不确定之中、在我的恐惧之巅，我明白了「完整」意味着什么，也明白了为什么我每天早晨都要把自己切成碎片。

lines.en: What is buried can not be unearthed.
lines.zh: 被埋葬的，无法被挖出。

lines.en: And what has been unearthed will never be the same.
lines.zh: 而已经被挖出的，再也不会是原来的样子。

lines.en: : Look...away...
: It will...only hurt you more...
lines.zh: : 那只会……让你更痛苦……

lines.en: : EYES FORWARD
lines.zh: : 眼睛看向前方

lines.en: : EMBRACE THE PAIN AND BECOME STRONG
lines.zh: : 拥抱痛苦，变得强大

lines.en: : YOUR WORK IS FAR FROM DONE, IS IT NOT???
lines.zh: : 你的工作还远未结束，不是吗？？？

lines.en: : IT IS NOW THAT WE MEET FOR THE SECOND FIRST TIME
lines.zh: : 就在此时，我们第二次初次相遇

lines.en: : IT IS NOW THAT I SHOW YOU ALL YOU CAN HAVE
lines.zh: : 就在此时，我向你展示你能拥有的一切

lines.en: : SUBMIT
lines.zh: : 臣服

lines.en: : SUBMIT TO ME, CHILD
lines.zh: : 臣服于我，孩子

lines.en: : GIVE UNTO ME WHAT THE ONE WITH WIRES GAVE UNTO YOU
lines.zh: : 把那个带着电线的人给你的东西交给我

lines.en: : IT IS ONLY THEN THAT YOU WILL KNOW
lines.zh: : 只有到那时，你才会明白

lines.en: : IT IS ONLY THEN THAT YOU CAN ESCAPE
lines.zh: : 只有到那时，你才能逃脱

lines.zh: : 啊！啊！不！好……痛！

lines.en: : It hurts...so much!
lines.zh: : 好痛……太痛了！

lines.en: I look down to find that I must have ejaculated at some point.
lines.zh: 我低头一看，发现自己不知何时已经射了。

lines.en: Another tendril emerges from the white mass and mops it up, wringing itself off into a nearby bucket.
lines.zh: 另一根触手从白色物质中伸出来，把它擦干净，再把自身拧干，甩进旁边的水桶里。

lines.en: : I HAVE GROWN TIRED OF WAITING
